statement: Real corpora are for the evaluation harness. The demo tenant is synthetic. A real fatality is never presented as a fictional site's record. Every fixture below is a synthetic replica; the real corpora are fetched by scripts/recall/fetch_corpora.py into a gitignored cache and are never committed. corpus_class='real_regulator' with tenant_use='demo_tenant' is refused at construction time, not warned about.
